rules: Reject unknown or duplicate columns, duplicate IDs, external image links and missing/ambiguous media binding. imageAnchor is the top-left A1 cell. Terms are JSON string arrays; required is true/false.
Legacy six-sheet files require a separately confirmed mapping preview. Missing explicit edges is SOP_MAPPING_REQUIRED; natural-language edges are never inferred.
Source registration fixes this format; existing FAQ remains unchanged. No new authorization domain.
message has only businessEntryId; decision/internal/end have only text. next has no label/ordinal/matchTerms; choice has all three.
All keys and entry references use the same source. Every node and edge has the exact FlowKey. IDs are unique within that graph.
One designated start; every node reachable from it; acyclic. Every message/internal has exactly one next; each decision has 2..4 choice edges and consecutive ordinals 1..N; end has no edges.
Message references a present enabled entry at the exact version; anchorEntry is also an exact dependency. Reject missing, disabled, cross-source or wrong-version dependencies.
Existing safety rules apply, including allergy body containing both stop and confirmation instructions.
Missing flow rows inherit; changes replace a complete graph; disable is a tombstone for an existing flow. Every changed dependency or media descriptor increments flowVersion, starting at 1.
Submitted entry media is a complete replacement. Empty removes all; ordinal starts at 1 without gaps; objectId binds once. Show removals in review differences.

canonical.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON; preserve body text without Unicode normalization. Object keys ASCII ascending; IDs ASCII, versions and ordinals numeric.
canonical.materialDigest: SHA256(canonical(complete material excluding its own digest)); includes graph, media, differences and mapping.
canonical.graphDigest: SHA256(canonical({definition,entries,media})); definition is FlowDefinition; entries are exact IntakePublishedEntry source wrappers for anchor and message references, deduplicated and sorted by EntryRef; media descriptors sorted by EntryRef,ordinal,objectId. A disabled graph may include disabled dependency tombstones.
canonical.overflow: FILE_LIMIT; preserve stricter upload/unzip limits. No truncation.

rules: sopDifferences covers every add/modify/disable/reenable. Source confirmation and review evidence bind the full materialDigest.
sopPlan binds materialDigest plus every changed FlowKey/graphDigest. Full-graph checks cover every branch and required image; no node sampling.
sopChecks set exactly matches the frozen plan, with no duplicates. Any graph defect prevents passing; client cannot submit passed state.
Expansion preserves old checks; unchanged graph may reuse only evidence with identical graphDigest and attribution. Revision invalidates confirmation and checks.
Status, freeze/check receipt and report expose the same sopPlan; rounds/report retain checks. History does not confer live permission.
Freeze material, complete graph and media descriptors atomically after verifying stored bytes hashes.
Under existing content lock recheck baseReleaseId, source mode/version, current authorization, approval, quality and exact dependency versions.
Write complete entry/graph/media release lineage and existing public.content_current in one transaction. Any failure rolls back all; unknown commit is recovered by the same operationId.
Only upsert graphs enter release lineage; do not drop inherited flows. Missing dependent entry changes require a graph revision before publication.
Rollback creates a new release by copying the entire chosen catalog and all lineage, with fresh authorization/source/object validation. Never independently rewind a SOP pointer.
Backup includes graph candidate/quality/lineage tables and every referenced media object, preserving ownership and ACL.

snapshot.description: Each page revalidates the current authenticated session, entitlement, source authority and selection. A flow is included only if its anchor and every message dependency pass the same entitlement/selection/time filters. Media binds only to entries included in the complete snapshot. Order collections faq,vocabulary,sopFlows,sopNodes,sopEdges,media; within collections use canonical sort. Pages may contain only graph/media. pageIndex starts at zero and is consecutive; empty snapshot is one page; last nextCursor is null. Each page repeats the same releaseId, entitlementId, contextGeneration, totals, pageCount and snapshotDigest. Cursor binds session, entitlement, release, selection, digest and next index; replay returns the same page or fails if invalidated.
clientValidation: Collect before execution; verify graphDigest, snapshotDigest, totals and page count.
Reject duplicate keys, mixed release, wrong/duplicate page, cyclic cursor, missing dependencies, unexpected final cursor or oversized item/page/collection.

media.description: Authenticate before resolving resources. Require entitlementId bound to session and release; recheck current publication, source query authority and exact entry-version/object binding. Return MediaPayload with no-store, never storage paths or permanent URLs. Main verifies decoded bytes length, MIME signature and SHA256, then exposes an opaque handle. Required media failure blocks advancement and copy; optional media may retry.

actionCheck.description: Read-only action check. Authenticate first; require exact current release, live entitlement, context generation, authorized full graph and graphDigest. Recheck source and all entry/media dependencies. open/restart only at startNodeId; next/choose require the specified outgoing edge of matching kind; copy only at message. back/observe require a node in the graph; Main additionally validates its actual stack. Return 204/no-store without persisting progress or renewing entitlement. New release returns409 SOP_RELEASE_CHANGED. No automatic sending or advancement.
actionCheck.displayDeadline: earlier of entitlement deadline and last successful check request-start monotonic time + 30 seconds
invalidation: Known revoke/logout/shop/selection change immediately clears progress, handles, content and generation; discard late responses.
Offline stops new actions; deadline clears displayed content. Collapsing does not pause expiry. Process restart/finish clears progress.
Clipboard and server check are not atomic. Copy only the current original message answer after check/media/generation validation; cannot retract prior copies.

rules: Only explicitly entered text; NFKC, Unicode case fold, trim, then nonempty substring matching.
Recommend only authorized flow entryTerms or current legal choice matchTerms. Display matching terms; order by FlowKey/ordinal.
Zero, one and multiple hits all require a human choice. No automatic transition, chat reading, screenshots or external model.

installation: Use the product migration runner and exact actual predecessor receipts; do not label this storage delta as migration 0078 or assume 0041 is the live predecessor.
Install storage delta with explicit grants only through existing restricted definer functions, fixed search_path, and no PUBLIC execute. Tables stay immutable.
Replace canonical_encoding/format guards for the graph discriminator; preserve the existing FAQ constraints and six-sheet historical reader. Never globally lift empty-array checks.
Extend parser/freeze to enforce every shape and relational invariant, dependency projection and canonical digest; store graph projections and media in the same transaction as material.
Extend quality freeze/check/read/report and existing publish/rollback to enforce exact target sets, inheritance and lineage; gate current pointer commit on complete graph/media lineage.
Use normalized graph lineage for graph-format snapshots; legacy release_catalogs SOP arrays stay empty. Do not create a second snapshot source or independent current pointer.
Implement entitlement-only reads and action check, bounded paging, MIME/hash preview and main-process progression; no SQL bypass from renderer.
Complete PG15 install/upgrade/ACL, graph mutation/quality/atomicity/rollback tests, HTTP/Main/Electron tests and backup restore before declaring consumer readiness.
